items.text:
Proud to join my colleagues in calling on Biden’s FDA to withdraw its guidance related to the distribution of life-saving treatments based on race.

Not only is this wrong, but it threatens the lives of patients. Thank you @RepDanBishop for leading this effort.

Thank you @MountCarmel for the tour of your operations in Grove City & for the update on COVID-19. 

Our nurses, doctors & front line healthcare workers work tirelessly to treat patients & protect our communities. We owe them all a debt of gratitude. https://t.co/sBoVjLH0L3

It was great to visit the @Battelle research facility in West Jefferson.

This facility does amazing work including helping destroy chemical weapons from the WWII era and essential medical research that helped create the Moderna vaccine.

A great asset for #OH15 https://t.co/phdBhIsJIf

It was great to meet Becca with @k9sforwarriors & learn about their mission of providing Service Dogs to Warriors to mitigate the debilitating symptoms of service-connected trauma. Thank you for all you do to help our veterans! https://t.co/yuu79nXiof

American Nitrile will soon be the largest nitrile glove manufacturer in the country, producing 3.6 billion medical & non-medical gloves per year & employing hundreds of Ohioans.

I was honored to tour their facility & witness the rebuilding of a critical domestic supply chain. https://t.co/BKblDXSNqN

Great meeting this morning with @BoundTreeMed - one of the largest national distributors of medical supplies & equipment for our EMS providers. 

Our EMTs & paramedics provide life saving services & we are lucky to have this company in Ohio to supply them across the country. https://t.co/CRtFw8gyUP

Happy to celebrate the 60th anniversary of @MadisonHealth this morning. A fantastic community hospital that provides health care close to home.

We must do all we can to ensure local hospitals can continue to operate & recruit the talent they need to keep our communities healthy. https://t.co/pZiUIZA4GP

At the sight of a lawsuit, the Biden Admin is scaling back their student loan handout. They knew it was wrong, borderline unconstitutional, and they did it anyway.

https://t.co/1c5tb1r96k

Proud to join my colleagues on this critical bill to address the worsening mental health crisis in our country. Those in need deserve better than suicide assistance on demand. If you or someone you know needs help, dial 988 for 24/7 trained assistance.
Receiving healthcare through the VA shouldn't be a life or death situation. @RepBost, @RepBalderson, and I are demanding answers from the VA on these two unnecessary veteran deaths in Ohio.

Wishing a safe and happy Thanksgiving to Ohio’s 15th Congressional District and beyond. This year, I’m thankful for my beautiful family, my health, and the opportunity to serve you in Congress and uphold our great Constitution. https://t.co/6pldUUobLy
Thanks to Pamela Gent with @AANP_NEWS for dropping by my office to discuss legislation impacting nurses and patients across the country. https://t.co/0TPXaaxjxN
Republicans will not cut social security or Medicare. That lie is pure fear mongering. #SOTU

Thank you to the great team at @OhioHealth for bringing my colleague, @RepBeatty, and myself together to discuss the work we’re doing in Washington on behalf of the healthcare industry and all of Central Ohio. https://t.co/3MIpXF52Az

I had the opportunity to tour @thebuckeyeranch today and discuss their approach to family-focused mental healthcare for our youth. 

I look forward to continue working with these great people and to seeing their future expansion in the coming years. https://t.co/ojE1YEfQbT

I've spoken with state & local leaders about the @nscorp train derailment in Clark County & will monitor the situation until cleanup is completed & power restored to all residents. Fortunately at this time, there is no indication of a risk to public health
https://t.co/B7XLjWfxzY
House Republicans want to protect and strengthen Medicare. Meanwhile, the Biden admin is proposing changes that could negatively impact seniors who rely on Medicare Advantage. Read more below ⬇️

Yesterday @HouseGOP passed the Protecting Taxpayers and Victims of Unemployment Fraud Act to address fraud & overpayments of pandemic unemployment insurance. 

Fraudsters stole billions of taxpayer dollars from expanded UI programs. Fixing this shouldn't be a partisan issue. https://t.co/mubOPzG5Od

Thanks @HouseVetAffairs for allowing me to participate in your hearing on the plagued VA Electronic Health Record System.

In Nov I sent a letter regarding two Ohio veterans that may have died as a result of the system's errors. Watch my questions about the EHR system below: https://t.co/hIsoX1DmA9

Our veterans caseworkers manned the Military Outpost at the @MemorialGolf to raise awareness of our office’s services and upcoming Veterans Wellness Day in August. 

They even had a chance to meet Medal of Honor recipient, Major General Patrick Henry Brady! https://t.co/qMBcbwgJ1f

Yesterday marked the end of PTSD Awareness Month. But that doesn’t mean the fight is over. If you’re a veteran struggling with PTSD or a mental health crisis, call 988 and press 1 for the Vets Crisis Line. https://t.co/pvXOwgNbML

This week, I introduced legislation to increase transparency in health care by requiring medical providers to disclose upfront the cost of X-Ray, CT, and MRI scans. https://t.co/rXh9Z4dL8S @WaysandMeansGOP https://t.co/VMMZ6sBrlK

Our bill to increase transparency in health care by requiring medical providers to disclose upfront the cost of X-Ray, CT, and MRI scans is on the move! https://t.co/rXh9Z4dL8S @WaysandMeansGOP https://t.co/XpTwXrIYZM
I joined @theboxershow this morning to discuss my new bill to unleash America’s energy independence. Listen to the full interview here: https://t.co/nPOGu3hn0n https://t.co/5ShVoLB0WA

Great to chat with @theboxershow this morning about the Farm Bill and my legislation to increase price transparency in health care. Listen to the full interview here: https://t.co/nPOGu3hn0n https://t.co/rIo8eZKTSi
